postmortem.review.postmortem: The checkout latency issue was attributed to inefficient database queries in the payment processing service. The root cause was identified through performance monitoring and log analysis, leading to the implementation of index optimization and query refactoring. These mitigations successfully reduced p99 checkout latency below the 400ms threshold across all affected regions. No further incidents were observed after post-resolution monitoring.
